raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 was delivered twice (02:00 and 05:00 on 2026-01-19), and the 05:00 copies duplicate 333 txn_ids from the 02:00 copies. The only differing column is ingest_ts, so the silver step double-counts those transactions, which causes both the duplicate keys and the inflated 2026-01-18 volume. Deduplicating on txn_id after the POSTED filter, keeping the earliest ingest_ts, removes the duplicates without changing any values.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) = 1;"}}
